authority.provider: Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan, CNS11643 Chinese Standard Interchange Code Full Character Database

visual_copybook.usage: independently rasterized topology comparison only; no outline, coordinate, or trace enters the image-generated glyph

policy.pass_definition: Exact requested scalar and Taiwan Traditional topology agree with current CNS mapping/stroke structure; the glyph remains directly recognizable at native, exact 2x nearest-neighbour, 128, 64, and 32 px; ink clears the grid; no stray thorn, wrong hook, missing or extra semantic stroke.
policy.reject_definition: Any uncertainty, simplified/incompatible variant, missing/extra semantic component, topology-changing join, wrong hook, reviewed-size unreadability, grid contact, stray ink, or thorn is REJECT.
policy.raster_limit: A final raster establishes visible topology but cannot prove the temporal act of writing each stroke.
policy.vectorization_limit: PASS permits controlled tracing of isolated image-generated dark ink only; grid lines, background variation, antialias halos, and CNS outlines are forbidden geometry.
policy.descriptor_mutation: This raster audit does not approve or modify source descriptors.

views: all 64 raw cells enlarged exactly 2x with nearest-neighbour pixels
43 high-risk raw cells separately enlarged exactly 2x
generated cell beside independently rasterized CNS TW-Kai
43 high-risk glyphs enlarged beside CNS topology
method.grid_detection: Exactly five long light-gray line groups per axis were detected by projection. No equal-division or guessed-grid fallback was accepted. Clearance is the minimum distance from L<100 ink to a cell boundary.
method.stray_component_detection: L<100 pixels in each raw cell were grouped by 8-connectivity. No component below 10 px exists. Components below 100 px occur only in visually located intended 馬／糸／鳥 short dot strokes in 驢、鸞、鷹.
artifact_review: current CNS code, stroke count, and stroke-sequence structure
Taiwan Traditional topology and simplified substitution
missing/extra semantic strokes and wrong turns/hooks
grid contact and stray dark components
sharp miter, thorn-like protrusion, and false connecting bridge
method.background_note: The near-white L>=245 standard deviation ranges from 1.19 to 1.28; background normalization remains mandatory before tracing.

legal_small_components.finding: visible intended short dot strokes in 馬 bottom 灬; not stray debris
visible intended short dot strokes in 䜌 double 糸; not stray debris
visible intended short dot strokes in 鳥 bottom 灬; not stray debris
